page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.13xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual instance powered by the KVM hypervisor on the x86_64 architecture. The server delivers 52 dedicated vCPUs backed by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. To balance this compute capacity, the instance allocates 96.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance does not include integrated graphics processing units or hardware accelerators.

Network infrastructure for the ecs.c6.13xlarge includes a baseline network throughput of 12 Gbps, while complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included. The configuration offers no integrated local storage, meaning that operating system volumes and application data must be hosted on external network block storage.

Because of the 1:1.85 vCPU-to-memory ratio and dedicated processor allocation, this server type is intended for parallel processing where CPU throughput is the dominant requirement. It is suited for batch processing systems, video encoding, software build and continuous integration clusters, and distributed application tiers that do not require high per-core memory capacities or local disk arrays.
